summary: Genuine re-entry after two missed weeks and chronically disrupted sleep. All easy aerobic cycling and low-volume strength. Zero intensity. Rebuild the habit, protect the nervous system.

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Ride
sessions.focus: Re-establish movement habit, aerobic stimulus without stress

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, 85-90 rpm, HR below 145 bpm
Z2 steady aerobic, 88-92 rpm, HR 146-158 bpm. If HR runs high due to fatigue, back off to low end of power window.
Z1 soft pedal, HR below 130 bpm before stopping

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Ride — Cadence Focus
sessions.focus: Aerobic efficiency and neuromuscular cadence work at low intensity

steps.description: Z1 easy spin, 85 rpm, HR settling below 145 bpm
Z2 cadence block — alternate each rep: 85 rpm / 95-100 rpm / 80 rpm / 90 rpm. HR 146-160 bpm. Reduce power if HR exceeds 165 bpm.
Z1 soft spin, breathe down, HR below 130 bpm

sessions.name: Bodyweight & Band Strength — Shoulder Safe
sessions.focus: Reactivate lower body and core, protect shoulder, build movement quality
sessions.notes: 2 rounds: 10x goblet squat 16kg, 10x RDL 16kg, 8x TRX split squat each leg, 15x banded glute bridge, 8x dead bug each side, 30s plank. Rest 60-75s between exercises, 90s between rounds. Avoid any shoulder loading — substitute dead bug for any pressing or pulling. Stop thoracic stretch if shoulder pinches.

steps.description: Leg swings front/back and lateral x10 each, hip circles x10 each direction, bodyweight squat x10 slow, glute bridge x10
2 rounds: goblet squat 16kg x10, RDL 16kg x10, TRX split squat x8 each leg, banded glute bridge x15, dead bug x8 each side, plank 30s. Rest 60-75s between exercises, 90s between rounds.
Hip flexor stretch 30s each side, lying hamstring stretch 30s each side, child's pose 30s, gentle thoracic rotation — skip if shoulder protests

summary: Begin a fresh base block. Three sessions, slightly longer main sets. All Z2 cycling. Introduce one short easy run in place of a ride if sleep has improved. Strength volume returns to 3 rounds.

sessions.name: Easy Aerobic Run
sessions.focus: Z1-Z2 run, conversational, 30 min, HR below 162 bpm

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — 3 Rounds
sessions.focus: Progressive return to 3-round strength circuit, shoulder safe

summary: Introduce first structured intensity: one sweet-spot cycling session (Z3, 142-168W). Run extends or adds light fartlek strides. Strength loads increase slightly. 80/20 intensity distribution maintained.

sessions.name: Sweet Spot Intro — 3x6 min
sessions.focus: First Z3 work, 142-165W intervals, build aerobic ceiling

sessions.name: Easy Run with Strides
sessions.focus: Z2 base run plus 4x20s light strides, neuromuscular sharpening

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Progressive Load
sessions.focus: Increase to 22kg goblet squat and RDL, 3 rounds, shoulder safe

summary: Peak week for this mini-block: one threshold cycling session (Z4, 169-195W), one quality run, one strength session. Highest intensity of the block, but volume remains capped at 30 min per session. Only execute if sleep and fatigue permit — if not, repeat week 3.

sessions.name: Threshold Repeats — 3x7 min
sessions.focus: Z4 threshold work 169-190W, sharpen aerobic ceiling, build toward FTP gains

sessions.name: Aerobic Run — Steady Effort
sessions.focus: Z2 sustained run, 25-30 min, HR 146-162 bpm, aerobic volume

sessions.name: Lower Body & Core — Peak Circuit
sessions.focus: 3 rounds at peak loads for this block, movement quality priority, shoulder safe
